brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Two-storey hex column structure (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full + piece:0,1,0;full + piece:0,1,1;full) provides stacked shelving volume; book prop placed on upper drawer top (prop:1) shows use as book shelf. No dedicated shelf plank/tray part exists in catalog, so display is via structure + props.

requirements.requirement: Rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Configurator checks fit/collisions only; parts are 3D-printed plastic with no load testing. No material/strength rating can be verified. Cannot claim 50 kg capacity.
drawer:0#1,0#cut on piece:1,0,0;half-n (level 0) and drawer:1#1,0#cut on piece:1,0,1;half-n (level 1) — two independent drawers with caps and joint bolts applied.

finish.summary: Built a two-level hex column with two half-base drawer bays providing two functional drawers; staged with book prop to show shelf use. House rules (capOpenFaces, lockJoints) applied. 50 kg rating cannot be met — plastic printed parts are not verified for load.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
